summary: Frontend-only testing of unified ARIADNI ID master industry-card system on /industries. Verified all 12 industry cards render with identical structure, live builder preview reacts to industry/accent selection, new red accent works, no console errors, no horizontal overflow at desktop (1440) or mobile (390). Regression on /feras-askar passed (all 4 action buttons visible).
critical_code_review_comments: IndustryCustomizer sources its industry buttons from lib/industries.js (INDUSTRIES) while the showcase cards use lib/industryCards.js (INDUSTRY_CARDS). IDs currently align, but keeping two parallel lists risks future drift (e.g. an id renamed in one file would silently break preview switching). Consider a single source of truth.

previewCardConfig uses form.accent as an ACCENT_OPTIONS id, but IndustryCustomizer's accent-id vocabulary is shared with SETS in accents.js. Fine today, but any new accent added to ACCENT_OPTIONS must also exist in SETS to avoid mismatched behaviors elsewhere.
IndustryCard portrait uses loading='lazy' with no width/height on , and the card is fixed at 360px. Minor CLS risk on slow networks — consider explicit dimensions.

Finance card reuses the same background image as Sales & Marketing (782d7af4...jpeg). Consider a distinct finance-specific asset for stronger visual differentiation as required by the spec ('DIFFERENT background image/mood per industry').
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 industry cards (ind-card-{id}) render on /industries with correct testids for actions (ind-action-{id}-call/email/whatsapp/save), exchange (ind-exchange-{id}) and label (ind-label-{id}). Live preview inside data-testid=showcase-preview reacts to industry-{id} clicks and accent-{id} swatches including new accent-red. No JS console errors, no horizontal overflow at 1440 or 390. /feras-askar regression clean (CALL/WHATSAPP/EMAIL/MESSAGE all present). Only observation: finance & sales share a background image.
